supersedes.reason: One enforced workflow, native readback truth, compact durable state and bounded verification.

intent.outcome: Users prompt once; managed work follows one enforced workflow while native host claims are readback-based and GUI-only checks stay owner-visible.

requirements.summary: No planner invention of scope or proof
Skills resolve once per packet generation
Affected verification before final full gate
Deterministic failures never become owner residuals
Release and cleanup are exact-SHA gated

decisions.statement: Managed runtime work uses AgentWorkflow with active routing and mandatory proof selection.
decisions.rationale: Direct, planner and pasted plans must not diverge.

decisions.statement: Native readback proves install/consumption; GUI model turns are separate owner checks.
decisions.rationale: A configuration file is not a mounted tool registry.

decisions.statement: Core install never mutates MCP configuration.
decisions.rationale: Ambient user MCP remains user-owned; integration actions own enablement.

decisions.statement: Artifacts are active-run compact; historical detail remains recoverable from Git.
decisions.rationale: Avoid .agent becoming larger than the product code.

tasks.objective: Admit v3 and dogfood its workflow contract.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime produces its own context/route receipts

tasks.objective: Cut managed work to one workflow and one proof/skill route.
acceptance_criteria: Pasted plans cannot skip proof routing
One route receipt per packet generation
tasks.rollback: Revert only the v3 workflow commit if a compatibility regression is proven.

tasks.objective: Unify native host inspection and fix real host surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Core install has zero MCP mutation
DSH and Command Code use native readback
No false success after readback failure
tasks.rollback: Transaction rollback restores agent-rules-owned bytes only.

tasks.objective: Make status and artifacts live, compact and diagnosable.
acceptance_criteria: Status does not use stale generated index
Architecture map names owners and checks
tasks.rollback: Generated documentation is optional and never status truth.

tasks.objective: Run scoped gates, release exact candidate, then clean inactive branches and artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Affected checks select only changed domains
Full gate runs once at release
CI is green on pushed SHA before cleanup
tasks.rollback: Do not delete branches or historical artifacts until remote CI accepts the final SHA.
